current_entrypoints.truth_boundary: Representative Chromium completed synthetic-audio transcription on the deployed route. This does not prove offline-first operation or private-audio acceptance.
Normal GET handler/gateway liveness is proven by HTTP 200. Full class transcription E2E is not implied.
DNS/connect/TLS succeeded but no first byte arrived before the bounded deadline. This is not an application PASS/FAIL.
Candidate source and static contract exist, but the served function remained ACTIVE v7 with unchanged digest; no deployment/runtime verification occurred.
The bounded probes deliberately sent no audio, transcript, session id, room token or credentials; private-audio transcription acceptance is therefore not established.

warmed_cache_observation.truth_boundary: Observed warmed-repeat improvement only; no offline-first claim.

later_browser_runtime_boundary.detail: A later Chromium runtime could not reach the public route because navigation was blocked by administrator policy. This does not invalidate the earlier successful GitHub Actions/Playwright proof.

egress_diagnosis.truth_boundary: General GitHub Actions egress was healthy; the target selftest path still produced no HTTP response after TLS.

status_basis: Discovery is no longer the accurate aggregate state: the browser transcription route has representative-browser proof and the authenticated study-transcribe handler has current liveness evidence, while heavy selftest/private-audio acceptance remain explicit boundaries.
remaining_acceptance_boundary: Deploy and independently verify the bounded ?selftest=probe candidate before making served-runtime claims about its phase diagnostics; full private-audio class transcription remains separately unproven.
prohibited_inference: Do not infer private-audio acceptance from synthetic browser audio or read-only probes.
Do not treat source-only bounded probe as Served.
Do not infer offline-first from warmed-cache improvement.
Do not promote Current, Served or Human Accepted from this reconciliation.
